Copycat's bundled fonts

Silkscreen Regular: display headings, main menu action labels, and score reveals.
Barlow Regular / SemiBold / Bold: player names, instructions, controls, and data.

Fonts are unmodified and self-hosted so the preview needs no remote font service.
Original sources:
https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/silkscreen
https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/barlow

Both families ship with their original SIL Open Font License in this directory.
